routes.name: Residence permit (overview)
routes.summary: Foreigners need a residence permit to stay in Curaçao. You apply with the Admission Organization for a specific purpose, like work, study, family, retirement or investment. Dutch and US nationals use a different process (see the declaration record).

other: Apply through the Admission Organization online portal. The office has 4 months to decide a first application.
Renewals can be filed from 4 months before expiry.

routes.processing: The Admission Organization has 4 months to decide on an application, per its site.

routes.name: Residence permit for employment
routes.summary: Your employer first applies for an employment permit. Once that is approved, you can apply for the residence permit. You must wait for the decision on a first application abroad.

other: The employment permit must be approved before the residence application.
Fees and other details not confirmed on the official page.

routes.processing: Up to 4 months for the residence decision, per the Admission Organization.

routes.name: Residence permit for sole proprietorship
routes.summary: To run your own business, you need a business permit from the Ministry of Economic Affairs first. Then you register with the Chamber of Commerce and the Labor Register, and then apply for the residence permit.

other: Business permit from the Ministry of Economic Affairs comes first.
Fees and other details not confirmed on the official page.

routes.name: Wealthy investor residence permit
routes.summary: For investors who put money into a business in Curaçao. Permit length depends on the investment. At XCG 1,500,000 the permit is for an indefinite period.

investment.note: Minimum business investment. XCG 750,000 gives 5 years and XCG 1,500,000 gives an indefinite permit.

other: The investment should create jobs, bring in foreign currency or boost the economy.
Must have enough means to meet the obligations of the investment.

stay.note: 3 years from XCG 500,000, 5 years from XCG 750,000, indefinite from XCG 1,500,000.

routes.processing: Up to 4 months, per the Admission Organization.

routes.name: Short stay permit (snowbird, remote worker, investor)
routes.summary: The Minister of Justice can grant a permit for up to 6 months. It covers wealthy investors, snowbirds (winter guests), remote workers and digital nomads, and regular employees staying 6 months or less.

other: Fees and income requirements not confirmed.

routes.name: Residence permit for retirees and rentiers
routes.summary: For people who live on their interest (rentier) or retirees. Retirees can also ask the Ministry of Finance about the penshonado arrangement.

other: Income and savings requirements, and fees, not confirmed on the page.

routes.name: Residence permit for study or internship
routes.summary: Needed to study or do an internship in Curaçao, no matter how long the internship is.

other: Fees and other details not confirmed on the official page.

routes.name: Residence permit for family (spouse, children, parents)
routes.summary: You can apply for your spouse or partner, children or parents. You must show enough money for each family member.

other: Specific income amounts not confirmed on the page.

routes.name: Declaration of lawful stay for Dutch and US nationals
routes.summary: Dutch and US citizens do not get a residence permit. They request a declaration instead, based on what the Admission Organization says on its permit and declaration page.

other: Also for people with a Curaçao-born Dutch parent, who request a different declaration.
